task_definition.task_description: Please look up up to five electronics headphones options, then check the recommendations for the Sony WH-1000XM5 black option and confirm the held order for one unit if available. After that, get info for Marriott New York, book a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13, then fetch the stay sheet for that hotel and publish it to my app with high priority. Also check the current ETH price, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, format that rate as a message, and then send it to me instantly.
